baseline_models.focus_anchor: The made-for-you, ritual-sign, eat, feed, subjected-for-you, and thank sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dedicated animal is assigned the status of public ritual sign; its ordered availability moves material benefit through self-consumption and feeding others, while gratitude returns recognition to the giver. The repeated for-you language therefore establishes entrusted use, not bare possession.

activation_trace.role: The dedicated sacrificial animal supplies the material body that enters the benefit circuit.
Assignment to a status makes the animal's ritual usefulness a conferred role rather than an ownership fact.
A legible ritual marker converts livestock into a sign whose handling bears public meaning.
Actual eating directs part of the animal into the offerers' nourishment.
Feeding another extends the benefit beyond the offerers and makes distribution integral to the rite.
Directed tractability enables the ordered use while locating its source outside human power.
Acknowledgment of benefaction is the intended human return produced by the completed circuit.

changed_reading.before: The verse grants an animal for sacrifice and permits charity afterward.
changed_reading.after: The verse constitutes an entrusted circuit in which a marked body becomes shared nourishment and the resulting recognition, rather than ownership, is the human response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The consecutive aligned, sides-fall, then-eat constructions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Linear bodily alignment is maintained until a definite fall onto the sides marks completion; only then does eating begin. Posture and aspect therefore create a visible threshold between living sign and distributable food.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on an even line supplies the stable pre-threshold posture.
Falling supplies the completed event that releases the next stage.
The bodily side gives the fall a concrete final orientation rather than an abstract death notice.
Eating is the action gated by the completed bodily fall.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists slaughter and eating instructions.
changed_reading.after: The verse scripts a controlled state transition: aligned living bodies become fallen bodies, and only across that observable boundary do they become food.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired recipient nouns immediately after the command to feed.
baseline_models.mechanism: One recipient root carries both contentment and asking, while the other carries exposure to benefaction and arrival at another's precinct seeking a need. The pair resists making one style of self-presentation the price of food.

activation_trace.role: Contentment supplies the recipient whose need may remain restrained or non-insistent.
Asking for benefaction keeps the same recipient term open to explicit request rather than fixing it as silent need.
Exposure to another's good supplies a recipient who presents need without requiring a formal verbal demand.
Coming to another's precinct as seeker supplies mobility and arrival as a second way need becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two fixed welfare categories, usually separated by whether they ask.
changed_reading.after: The paired terms preserve a spectrum from contained need through exposed or arriving need, so distribution cannot depend on one approved performance of poverty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from good and feeding to the final purpose of gratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gratitude inventory includes a little input producing a visible effect, fullness, and fresh growth. Coupled with feeding, this makes gratitude materially diagnostic: received good should become perceptible sufficiency or new benefit beyond the first recipient.

activation_trace.role: Generosity and gift supply the good received rather than merely an advantageous property.
Feeding another gives the received good an outward, observable effect.
A small provision yielding visible condition supplies the productivity test for gratitude.
Fullness and abundance supply the bodily endpoint that shared food can produce.
Fresh shoots supply an image of benefit continuing beyond its initial material input.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is a verbal or inward response appended to the sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible yield of the gift: food becomes another person's sufficiency, so acknowledgment is embodied as propagated benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere, experienced good can become the unstable condition of edge-worship, whereas animal provision is explicitly paired with feeding need and the surah closes by joining enacted good to flourishing. These cues revise the focus's good-for-you from private advantage into benefit completed by circulation.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial good anchors the focus claim that the animal contains advantage for the addressees.
Feeding others provides the focus's own route by which advantage leaves private possession.
Experienced benefit supplies the unstable private-good model on which conditional worship can rest.
Allocated gift reframes the animal as provision received before it can be redistributed.
Material need supplies the destination that tests whether received benefit has become shared good.
Good as an action, not merely an experience, turns the focus benefit into a commandable practice.
Flourishing and lasting success supply the result of doing, rather than hoarding, the good.

structural_cues: 22:11 makes received good a test of whether worship is merely conditional.
22:28 repeats the eat-and-feed sequence while explicitly naming provision and poverty.
22:77 places doing good immediately before the prospect of flourishing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contrast between experienced benefit, allocated provision, need, and enacted good. I infer that circulation is the directional test converting benefit into good. A live alternative is that these are parallel ethical themes rather than a definition of the focus's good.

changed_reading.before: The good in the animal is the benefit its owners may take from it.
changed_reading.after: The animal's benefit becomes good-for-you precisely through a circuit that reaches need; private advantage alone remains spiritually unstable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sanctuary is made equally accessible to the one who stays and the one from outside, and the preceding feeding instruction names material need. This social geometry sharpens the focus recipient pair: the sacrificial meal performs equal access across settled, restrained, exposed, and arriving positions.

activation_trace.role: Contented restraint supplies the recipient whose need can remain socially quiet.
Arrival at another's precinct seeking a need supplies the mobile or outside recipient.
Equality between two positions supplies the sanctuary's access rule and the meal's social measure.
Staying in devoted attendance supplies the settled side of the access contrast.
The outside or non-urban position supplies the arriving side that must receive equal access.
Concrete lack prevents the equality model from remaining only spatial or ceremonial.

structural_cues: 22:25 describes the sanctuary as made for people on equal terms across resident and outsider positions.
22:27 has pilgrims arrive from every deep route.
22:28 turns the gathered provision toward a person in material need.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal sanctuary access, incoming pilgrims, and recipient terms with restrained and arriving branches. I infer that the shared meat materializes the sanctuary's equality. A live alternative is that the resident-outsider and recipient pairs are adjacent but not socially coextensive.

changed_reading.before: Feeding the two recipients is an isolated charitable addition to sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: The meal enacts the sanctuary's equal-access order by carrying its provision across differences in residence, mobility, and how need appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places universal lowering before a sanctuary sequence of standing, bowing, and prostration, then contrasts it with the uncontrolled fall of association. Against that field, the animal's aligned stance and completed side-fall can function as an embodied, ordered descent under the divine name rather than a merely mechanical collapse.

activation_trace.role: Even alignment supplies the animal's ordered upright phase.
Completed falling supplies the animal's controlled descent.
Lowering in submission supplies the surah-wide bodily field in which nonhuman beings also participate.
Bodily standing supplies the first posture in the sanctuary's ordered devotional descent.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the transitional posture between standing and full lowering.
Head-lowering and bodily inclination complete the sanctuary's ordered posture sequence.
A noisy, disordered fall supplies the negative counterpart to the focus's bounded descent.
Plunging into an abyss supplies the uncontained trajectory from which the named ritual fall differs.

structural_cues: 22:18 includes earthbound creatures within universal prostration.
22:26 orders sanctuary bodies as standing, bowing, and prostrating.
22:31 figures association as uncontrolled falling and plunging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two posture sequences and a contrast between ordered lowering and uncontrolled fall. I infer an embodied analogy between worshippers' descent and the animal's aligned fall. A live alternative is that the focus posture remains entirely procedural and the resemblance is only visual.

changed_reading.before: Alignment steadies the animals and their fallen sides merely indicate death.
changed_reading.after: The stance-to-side sequence can make the animal itself a bodily sign of ordered surrender, sharply distinguished from the disintegrating fall used to image association.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah explicitly denies that flesh or blood reaches God and affirms protected, reverent orientation as what reaches. This separates two outputs already latent in the focus: material goes horizontally through eating and feeding, while Godward response is nonmaterial recognition and guarded conduct.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another anchors the humanward destination of the material body.
Acknowledgment anchors the nonmaterial response directed back toward the giver.
Reaching supplies the explicit destination test, negated for materials and affirmed for piety.
Literal flesh supplies one material explicitly excluded from a Godward transfer.
Literal blood supplies the second material explicitly excluded from a Godward transfer.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the guarded orientation that can reach where flesh and blood cannot.

structural_cues: 22:37 uses the same destination verb for the negated material pair and the affirmed piety.
The focus sends flesh toward eaters before the next ayah denies its Godward arrival.
22:37 continues from subjection to magnification, guidance, and good-doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit material-versus-piety destination contrast. I infer a two-vector economy: flesh moves toward people and reverent recognition toward God. A live alternative is that the next ayah only corrects sacrificial theology, though the adjacent feeding command still supports the destination split.

changed_reading.before: The sacrifice and its distributed meat jointly constitute an offering transferred toward God.
changed_reading.after: No material is transferred to God: the body is routed to human nourishment, while piety and grateful magnification are the Godward outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same subjection formula later encompasses earth and ship, while the sky is held from falling except by permission and the frame closes with tenderness, mercy, and human ingratitude. The focus's permitted side-fall is thus one bounded release inside a larger regime of holding and care, not a license for unqualified mastery.

activation_trace.role: Directed tractability anchors the human availability whose limits the later cosmic use exposes.
The animal's actual fall supplies the local release placed against the later held fall.
Cosmic directed availability broadens subjection beyond livestock and locates all human use within one giver's ordering.
Holding back supplies restraint as the complement to making something available.
Falling and coming to rest supply the cosmic counterpart whose release remains permission-bound.
Tender compassion supplies the governing quality around cosmic holding and availability.
Merciful softness makes care, not domination, the containing frame for subjection.
Covering over a blessing supplies the direct negative of the focus's intended gratitude.

structural_cues: 22:65 repeats the focus's subjected-for-you formula on a cosmic scale.
The same ayah couples availability with holding the sky from a permissionless fall.
22:66 follows life, death, and renewed life with the charge that the human is deeply ungrateful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared subjection language, a held-versus-permitted fall, compassion, and the gratitude contrast. I infer that granted use is structurally bounded by the giver's restraint and care. A live alternative is that cosmic preservation illustrates power without directly limiting sacrificial agency.

changed_reading.before: Subjection means the animal has been placed under unilateral human control.
changed_reading.after: Subjection means permissioned availability within a compassionate holding-and-release order; gratitude requires using that delegated capacity without converting it into absolute mastery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's early earth sequence moves from lifeless dryness through activation, growth, and new emergence, while its later life-death-life sequence prevents death from being the final horizon. Joined to the focus gratitude branches of visible yield and fresh growth, the animal's fall becomes an obligation against waste: ended animal life must be converted into nourishment and renewed social sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The completed fall supplies the apparent endpoint whose material aftermath the model follows.
A small input producing visible condition supplies the focus's own yield logic.
Fresh growth supplies the focus branch that lets gratitude resonate with regeneration.
Dried lifelessness supplies the apparently exhausted material state from which change begins.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supply activation after apparent stillness.
Nourishment and growth supply the intermediate conversion from received input to increased life.
Plant emergence supplies the visible new yield produced by the regenerative sequence.
Living creaturehood at both ends supplies the wider life horizon around the intervening death.
Loss of life supplies the real interruption that the surrounding sequence refuses to make ultimate.

structural_cues: 22:5 renders apparently dead earth as a staged material transformation into growth.
22:66 places death between two divine givings of life.
The focus sends the fallen body immediately into eating and feeding, not disposal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regenerative earth, life-death-life, and a focus branch where gratitude appears as growth. I infer a material ethic of conversion from fallen body to sustaining food. A live alternative is that resurrection and vegetation only establish divine power and should not be mapped onto sacrificial redistribution.

changed_reading.before: Once the animal falls, distribution is a useful aftermath of completed death.
changed_reading.after: The fall creates a duty of regenerative use: the ended life must not terminate in waste but become food, sufficiency, and a visible yield of gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice says that a rite is assigned to every community, links sacrificial practice to voiced naming and surrender, and then blocks ritual contest. The focus's detailed choreography is therefore a concrete assigned form within plural communal rites, while its unifying axis is acknowledgment of the one giver and ethical surrender.

activation_trace.role: Assignment to a status anchors the focus choreography as something instituted rather than naturally universal.
Assigning each community a form supplies institutional plurality across communities.
Sacrificial devotion supplies the specific ritual domain in which the plurality operates.
Voiced mention supplies a shared orientation that can persist across different assigned forms.
Naming as designation supplies the common referent around which the rites are ordered.
Handing over and surrender supply the common human posture beneath formal plurality.
Practiced devotion supplies the repeated claim that every community inhabits an assigned rite.
Mutual pulling between sides supplies the contest that ritual plurality is not meant to generate.

structural_cues: 22:34 assigns a rite to every community and immediately directs all toward one deity and surrender.
22:67 repeats the every-community assignment and tells opponents not to contest the matter.
The focus supplies one unusually concrete posture, timing, and distribution choreography.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated communal assignment, one divine orientation, and a prohibition on ritual contest. I infer that formal specificity is local embodiment rather than a claim that every community must share identical mechanics. A live alternative is that the plural assignments are historical stages and the focus remains the final uniform form.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives the universal sacrificial template against which all rites should be measured.
changed_reading.after: The focus gives one concretely assigned communal form whose universal core is naming the giver, surrendering, and turning provision into ethical benefit rather than enforcing identical choreography.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a non-dominant mapping from name toward visible marking and a marked public season. It remains anchored to the focus's name word and its explicit ritual-sign construction. Downstream prose should present it as branch resonance, not replace the ordinary lexical sense of uttering the divine name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ritual-sign noun and the command to voice the name over the aligned animals.

activation_trace.role: A ritual marker supplies the already public, legible status of the animal.
Voicing on the tongue supplies the audible act by which the status is declared.
Name as designation supplies the ordinary identifying force of the utterance.
A visible identifying mark supplies the exploratory sense that naming publicly reclassifies the body.
A marked season of assembly supplies the exploratory public-event scale of the naming act.

changed_reading.before: Naming is an uttered label placed over an otherwise unchanged act of slaughter.
changed_reading.after: The uttered name can also be heard as publicly marking body and gathering as belonging to a sacred season, making the act socially legible before the body falls.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the surah's smallest creature and its anti-idolatry parable to the handling of a very large sacrificial body. It remains anchored to the focus's claim of subjection and the parable's creation, rescue, weakness, and seeking branches. Downstream prose should qualify it as a scale-reversal critique of autonomous mastery, not as an additional slaughter rule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The claim that the large sacrificial animals were made tractable for the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Great bodily size supplies the large-scale creature that humans appear able to control.
Directed tractability anchors that control as granted availability rather than self-originating human force.
Creative origination supplies the capacity denied to the invoked powers even at tiny scale.
The fly supplies the tiny creature whose agency reverses the apparent hierarchy of control.
Inability to extract something from another's hold supplies the failure of autonomous rescue and control.
Lack of strength supplies the explicit diagnosis beneath pretended mastery.
Seeking supplies both sides of the failed transaction and exposes dependence rather than command.

changed_reading.before: Humans control the large animals because human strength makes them masters of lesser creatures.
changed_reading.after: Control of the large body is itself a received gift: the fly reversal exposes every claim of autonomous mastery, so subjection should produce gratitude and restraint rather than self-deification.

strongest_changes: The post-focus destination contrast makes the material body humanward nourishment while piety and grateful magnification are the Godward outcome.
Repeated subjection plus the held-versus-permitted cosmic fall turns human control into bounded, compassionate availability rather than absolute mastery.
Sanctuary equality and the recipient-root ambiguity make feeding an enactment of access across settled, arriving, restrained, and exposed need.
The standing-to-fall sequence can operate as an embodied sign of ordered surrender, contrasted with the surah's uncontrolled fall of association.
Repeated assignment of rites to every community relocates universality from identical mechanics to naming, surrender, and ethical use of provision.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah field did more than explain sacrificial procedure: controlled fall, equal access, plural rites, material non-arrival, cosmic holding, regeneration, and the fly's scale reversal transformed the focus into a compact model of delegated power, public redistribution, and embodied surrender.
remaining_uncertainties: The analogy between animal posture and worshipper posture is visually and sequentially strong but remains reader-supplied.
The resident-outsider pair and the two food recipients need not denote identical social groups.
The regenerative model is a material and ethical analogy, not a claim that killing itself causes spiritual renewal.
The name-to-mark-and-season activation depends on a non-dominant mapped root and must remain explicitly exploratory.
